purpose: Development-only visible Vibe-Footprint feature research; not an independent holdout.

features.name: style_pattern_breadth
features.formula: positive(responsive, hover, animation, gradient, blur, rounded, shadow, dark) / 8

features.name: semantic_landmark_density
features.formula: min(1, (main + navs + footers + article + sections) / dom_tags)

features.name: semantic_pattern_breadth
features.formula: positive(main, navs, footers, article, sections, lists, forms, tables) / 8

features.name: vector_asset_share
features.formula: svgs / (svgs + images), or 0 when both are absent

features.name: stylesheet_resource_share
features.formula: stylesheets / (stylesheets + scripts), or 0 when both are absent
